origin.thread_label: Temporal integrity / lookahead leakage kill test v1 (E1X)

title: Anchor PDLT discovery labels on the last candle CLOSED by the CFGI timestamp
objective: In scripts/experiments/pdlt_discovery.py, locate() returns the last 4h candle whose OPEN is <= the CFGI timestamp and forward_stats() uses that candle's CLOSE (open+4h) as the decision-time start price, so every discovery label is anchored 0-4h after the signal. Restrict the anchor to the last candle whose close time (open_time + interval) is <= the CFGI timestamp, keep label horizons measured from that anchor, and state the 4h boundary granularity in the report. This is a repair of the discovery methods only; it must not reopen PDLT, schedule any workflow or produce a frozen model.

evidence.summary: E1X harness, tests, report and findings evidence. Candidate must not land before this evidence PR is merged.

20/20 outputs fail; the only changed fields are 72h.start/7d.start/14d.start; minimal future suffix = 1 record (the 4h candle containing the CFGI timestamp), lead 13246 s (unaligned) / 14400 s (aligned). The completed-candle locate passes (RT-A07-...-REPAIR_CANDIDATE_COMPLETED_CANDLE).
308 live CFGI 4h rows were first captured 72-879 s after their timestamp (unaligned minutes, e.g. 21:19:14Z): the timestamp is the knowledge time.

Provider-value-free restricted precheck: archive CFGI_PDLT_HISTORICAL_BOOTSTRAP_V1 binds raw authority bytes=86964 sha256=68c554963b87f860efb0e4b6c40cd2bd6ecc1f3a7027956032b87edb35f1ebf8, row/object count=1230, completeness COMPLETE_FOR_ORIGINAL_PDLT_BOOTSTRAP_ARTIFACT, validation HASH_VERIFIED_AND_ORIGINAL_PDLT_VALIDATED. Private README states timeframe=4h is algorithm timeframe while provider observations arrive at roughly 15-minute cadence, supporting observation-time rather than 4h-period-start semantics. No restricted provider values copied.

reproduction: python -m unittest tests.experiments.test_strategy_factor_leakage_e1_production.E1XProductionFindingsTest.test_pdlt_discovery_anchor_uses_unclosed_candle. Minimal: candles opening 00:00/04:00/08:00, when=05:00Z; locate() returns the 04:00 candle and forward_stats() uses its 08:00 close. Real PDLT inputs are restricted-plane; real-data magnitude is PRIVATE_DATA_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE and is not claimed.

positive: E1X RT-A07 PRODUCTION passes (no start field changes when candles closing after the CFGI timestamp are poisoned).
A CFGI timestamp exactly equal to a candle close anchors on that candle.
negative: A candle whose close is after the CFGI timestamp is never the anchor.
No threshold quantile, horizon, split boundary, purge or FNP semantics change.
pdlt-discovery-once.yml remains blocked; no model or forecast artifact is written.
